build_polynomial_features: build polynomial feature matrix from input data with specified degree and interaction options
create_interaction_only_features: create polynomial interaction-only features excluding powers of individual input features
generate_spline_basis_functions: generate univariate B-spline basis functions for continuous features with configurable knots and degree
transform_data_with_splines: transform continuous features into B-spline basis columns with configurable extrapolation behavior
get_polynomial_feature_names: get descriptive output feature names for polynomial transformations including bias and interaction terms
